why: rclc has no action removal either (its `rclc_executor_remove_*` family covers subscription, timer, client, service and guard condition only). The arena entry `rclc_executor_add_action_client` registers holds the client struct as its callback context, and `rcl_action_client_fini` is handed only the entity, so it cannot undo the entry, `handle_count` or the trigger table; this does all three, dropping the entry so the action leaves the graph and its slot and bytes are reused. Issue 1609.
